name: US dollar
summary: Dollar index near 104.0 on 27 Nov, 4.6% higher over three months and inside the 5% line
state: The DXY dollar index ended near 104.0 on 27 Nov, just below its 52-week high of 104.3 and 4.6% higher over three months, inside the 5% Watch line (Yahoo Finance). The level sits within the 90–108 range, and SOFR was 5bp above the Fed's reserve rate on 25 Nov (FRED), so no dollar funding stress from swap lines is visible.
for_you: A firm dollar raises the cost of dollar-priced imports such as fuel for other countries. The move is still within its normal range.
rubric_hit: DXY 3m move 4.61% below the 5% Watch line
why: The dollar is the world's funding currency; violent moves squeeze emerging markets and anyone with dollar debts.
drivers: Fed vs other central banks, safe-haven demand, trade policy, reserve diversification.

rubric.alert: DXY moved > 8% in 3 months, or dollar funding stress (Fed swap lines drawn materially).
rubric.watch: DXY moved 5–8% in 3 months, or outside 90–108.
rubric.normal: DXY moved < 5% over 3 months and is between 90 and 108.
